_about: Prompts used to generate the product photography (model: gpt-image-2.5-sunburst, 16:9, 1K). Every product prompt = prefix + subject + style, so the whole catalog shares one look.
prefix: Editorial product photograph for a premium kosher butcher shop's online catalog. Subject:
style: Raw, fresh, uncooked meat with true-to-life color and a natural moist matte surface, realistic fat and muscle grain — no glossy, waxy, or plastic look. Presented on a matte dark charcoal slate board resting on a dark walnut wood table, a few flakes of coarse sea salt and a single sprig of fresh rosemary beside it. Soft directional window light from the upper left, gentle natural shadows, deep dark moody background. Shot on a full-frame camera with a 100mm lens from a 35-degree angle, shallow depth of field, subject centered with generous margin. No text, no labels, no packaging, no hands, no people.

subjects.ribeye-steak: two thick-cut raw beef ribeye steaks, boneless, with rich intramuscular marbling and the characteristic fat cap "eye", one laid flat and one leaning slightly against it.
subjects.chuck-eye-steak: two raw beef chuck eye steaks, about one inch thick, oval shaped with visible marbling and a small seam of fat, resembling a smaller ribeye.
subjects.brisket-first-cut: a whole raw beef brisket first cut (flat), a long rectangular even slab of lean deep red meat with a thin trimmed white fat cap along the top edge.
subjects.brisket-second-cut: a raw beef brisket second cut (point / deckle), a thicker irregular rounded piece with generous marbling and visible seams of fat running through it.
subjects.short-ribs-flanken: raw beef flanken short ribs cut across the bone, several half-inch strips each showing three round cross-sections of rib bone with marbled meat between them, neatly arranged in an overlapping row.
subjects.top-of-the-rib: a raw boneless beef top of the rib (deckle) roast, a flat thick piece of well-marbled coarse-grained meat with a fat layer on one side, tied with natural butcher's twine.
subjects.beef-neck: several thick raw bone-in beef neck slices, round cross-sections with a central vertebra bone surrounded by deep red meat and connective tissue.
subjects.london-broil: a raw London broil, a single thick lean oval slab of beef about two inches thick with a fine tight grain and very little fat.
subjects.mock-tender: a raw beef mock tender roast, a lean cone-shaped tapered piece of shoulder meat with a tight grain and a thin silver membrane.
subjects.minute-roast: a raw beef minute roast (top blade), a flat rectangular shoulder roast showing the thin line of connective tissue running down the center, tied with butcher's twine.
subjects.silver-tip-roast: a raw beef silver tip roast, a large lean compact rounded roast neatly tied with several loops of natural butcher's twine.
subjects.rib-fingers: a row of raw beef rib fingers, long narrow strips of well-marbled meat taken from between the rib bones, laid side by side.
subjects.tapa-de-asado: a raw tapa de asado (beef rib cap), a wide flat piece of meat with a smooth fat cap on top and visible marbling along the cut edge, partially folded.
subjects.pop-muscle: a raw beef pop muscle (shoulder clod heart), a lean, dense, rounded oblong shoulder roast with fine grain and a thin layer of fat.
subjects.beef-shank: three thick raw beef shank cross-cut slices (osso buco style), each with a round marrow-filled bone in the center surrounded by red meat and connective tissue.
subjects.filet-mignon-tenderloin: a whole raw center-cut beef tenderloin with two thick filet mignon medallions cut from its end placed in front, fine tender grain, trimmed clean of silver skin.
subjects.picanha: a raw picanha (beef top sirloin cap), a triangular cut with a thick smooth white fat cap scored in a crosshatch, plus two thick picanha steaks cut from it lying beside.
subjects.new-york-strip: two raw New York strip steaks, about one and a half inches thick, with a strip of white fat along one edge and fine marbling.
subjects.rump-steak: two raw beef rump steaks, lean thick oval steaks with tight grain and a thin rim of fat.
subjects.ground-beef: a generous mound of freshly ground raw beef with distinct coarse strands from the grinder, rich red with flecks of white fat.
subjects.beef-burgers: four thick hand-formed raw ground beef burger patties stacked in two short stacks, coarse ground texture with a slight dimple in the center of each.
subjects.beef-kebabs: five raw Middle-Eastern style ground beef kebabs, elongated hand-shaped portions of minced beef mixed with finely chopped parsley and onion, each molded around a flat metal skewer.
subjects.beef-stew-cubes: a heap of raw beef stew meat cut into even one-and-a-half-inch cubes, deep red with small seams of fat.
subjects.beef-stir-fry-strips: a pile of thin raw beef stir-fry strips, sliced against the grain, evenly cut lean red ribbons of meat.
subjects.whole-lamb: a whole dressed raw lamb carcass, skinned and clean, pale pink meat with creamy white fat, laid lengthwise on a large rustic wooden butcher block, shown in full.
subjects.half-lamb: half of a dressed raw lamb carcass split lengthwise, showing the pale pink meat, the ribs, loin and leg, laid on a large wooden butcher block.
subjects.lamb-rack: a raw frenched rack of lamb with eight clean exposed rib bones curving upward, a smooth layer of fat over pink eye of meat.
subjects.lamb-rib-chops: six raw frenched lamb rib chops arranged in a fan, each a small round eye of pink meat with a long clean bone.
subjects.lamb-loin-chops: four thick raw lamb loin chops, T-shaped bone with a small round loin eye on one side and tenderloin on the other, thin fat rim.
subjects.lamb-shoulder: a whole raw bone-in lamb shoulder, pink meat with an even layer of white fat, large irregular roast shape.
subjects.lamb-shoulder-chops: three raw lamb shoulder blade chops, roughly round with a section of blade bone and several small muscles separated by fat seams.
subjects.lamb-leg-bone-in: a whole raw bone-in leg of lamb with the shank bone end exposed, smooth pale fat covering over pink meat.
subjects.boneless-lamb-leg: a raw boneless leg of lamb rolled and tied with natural butcher's twine at even intervals, pink meat with a thin fat layer.

subjects.lamb-breast: a raw lamb breast, a flat thin rectangular piece with layers of pink meat and white fat and rib bones visible on the underside edge.
subjects.lamb-ribs: a rack of raw lamb spare ribs (riblets), narrow ribs with layers of pink meat and fat between them.
subjects.lamb-flank: a raw lamb flank, a thin flat piece of pink meat with visible long muscle fibers and a light fat layer, partially rolled.

site.hero: Editorial photograph for a premium kosher butcher shop's website hero. A dark, moody overhead-angled still life on a long dark walnut butcher block: a thick marbled raw ribeye steak, a frenched rack of lamb, a raw picanha with scored fat cap, a small bowl of coarse sea salt, whole black peppercorns, a vintage carbon-steel butcher's knife and sprigs of rosemary and thyme. Soft directional window light from the left, rich deep shadows, true-to-life raw meat colour, natural matte texture, no plastic look. Shot on a full-frame camera, 50mm lens. No text, no labels, no people.
site.craft: Editorial photograph for a premium kosher butcher shop's website: the inside of a traditional butcher shop workroom, a heavy end-grain wooden butcher block with a carbon-steel boning knife, a honing steel and neatly trimmed raw beef cuts, hanging hooks and white tiles softly out of focus in the background. Warm low-key lighting, deep shadows, documentary realism. No text, no logos, no people.
